responsibility: Implements explicit Rust cast checking for the typechecker. The file first reuses coercion rules when an as-cast can be satisfied by normal coercion, then applies the frontend’s simple cast matrix for inference variables, numeric types, booleans, chars, and pointer/reference-to-pointer/reference conversions, including mutability checks for reference casts, and finally emits the cast diagnostic for invalid conversions.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual explicit-cast checker: it tries coercion first, applies the cast-rule matrix for numeric, bool, char, and pointer/reference cases, and emits invalid-cast diagnostics. Unlike rust-casts.h, this file contains the decision logic and diagnostics rather than the TypeCastRules interface.
